stem:
Walia counts seven pebbles by matching each pebble to one clap in order, from clap 1 through clap 7.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The ordered clap sequence alone counts the pebbles even if some pebbles are skipped.
One-to-one matching works only with written Hindu numerals, not with claps.
Each pebble is matched exactly once to one clap, so the ordered claps show that there are seven pebbles.
Seven is correct because the word seven is the largest word written on the board.

teacher.key_rationale: Counting needs a one-to-one match between objects and an ordered standard sequence. Claps are a valid sequence when each pebble is matched exactly once.
